WITH picked AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM leads
    WHERE status = 'new'
      AND retry_count < {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
      AND website_url IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(website_url) <> ''
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    LIMIT {{ $('config').first().json.batchSize }}
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE leads l
SET
    status     = 'enriching',
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM picked
WHERE l.id = picked.id
RETURNING
    l.id,
    l.business_name,
    l.website_url,
    l.retry_count,
    l.city,
    l.category,
    l.source,
    l.external_id;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,

  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (

UPDATE public.leads
SET
  failure_reason =
    '{{ (
      $json.failure_reason ||
      "Enrichment failed"
    ).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',

  retry_count =
    retry_count + 1,

  status =
    CASE
      WHEN retry_count + 1 >=
        {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
      THEN 'enrich_failed'
      ELSE 'new'
    END,

  updated_at = NOW()

WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

RETURNING

  status,
  retry_count,
  failure_reason;

WITH recovered AS (
  UPDATE public.leads
  SET
    retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    status = CASE
      WHEN retry_count + 1 >= {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
        THEN 'enrich_failed'
      ELSE 'new'
    END,
    failure_reason = CASE
      WHEN retry_count + 1 >= {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
        THEN 'Enrichment timed out after 20 minutes'
      ELSE 'Recovered stale enrichment; retry scheduled'
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'enriching'
    AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
  RETURNING status
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS recovered_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE status = 'enrich_failed'
  ) AS terminal_failed_count
FROM recovered;
